best-i18n: `t` is a compile-time macro and can only be used at its call site (a.tsx offset 177). A dependency array wants the locale, not the macro: read it with `useLocale()` and depend on that variable, then silence `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` for the line. Depending on nothing would leave the text in the previous language after a switch.

  https://best-i18n.aiwan.run/docs/errors/dependency-array
